judged.play: Streamer talks to chat before the match starts during Lotus map loading.
judged.reason: Pre-match chatter with chat about schedule and qualification requirements with no action.

judged.play: 100 Thieves holds site in round 2 and trades standard kills to win the eco round.
judged.reason: Routine eco round hold without any extraordinary individual plays.

judged.play: Cryo scores clean kills with a pistol to secure a flawless round for 100T.
judged.line: Cryo is killing it with this gun!
judged.reason: Clean flawless round, but pales in comparison to the insane multi-kills and clutches later.

judged.play: Bang executes a monstrous 4K spray down with Clove, forcing an early enemy timeout.
judged.line: Bang might be the best player on the planet bro!
judged.reason: An unbelievable 4K multi-kill that triggers maximum excitement and an early opponent timeout.

judged.play: Streamer discusses how watching pro gameplay makes him want to play games during a timeout.
judged.reason: Casual stream chat during a match timeout with zero gameplay happening.

judged.play: 100T shuts down enemy Neon's aggression on A site.
judged.line: Put the knife in the pocket, you're not that guy.
judged.reason: Amusing commentary about the opponent, but the round play itself is fairly routine.

judged.play: Streamer listens in on 100 Thieves calm and structured team communications.
judged.line: Look at the clean comms guys!
judged.reason: Interesting behind-the-scenes listen-in, but lacks a dramatic play moment.

judged.play: Streamer briefly mentions his peak Valorant rank at round start.
judged.line: I think I was Ascendant highest man.
judged.reason: Short personal anecdote without any relevant gameplay action.

judged.play: Cryo lands an extraordinary hero Operator headshot through a wall/smoke.
judged.line: OH MY GOD! What did I just watch?!
judged.reason: Incredible, unexpected Operator shot that draws a genuine head-in-hands shock reaction.

judged.play: Bang clutches an intense 1v2 post-plant situation with immaculate positioning and aim.
judged.line: GET HIM OUT OF HERE! He's not human, he's THAT guy!
judged.reason: A clutch highlight of the highest order that has the streamer jumping out of his seat.

judged.play: Asuna hits a stylish jumping classic headshot to close out a round.
judged.line: Asuna with a classic jumping headshot! You love to see it!
judged.reason: Fun stylish shot, though it gets outshone by Bang's game-defining plays.

judged.play: Streamer explains why he got back into watching VCT esports.
judged.line: Sign me up man, I'm back on.
judged.reason: Narrative commentary about his viewing habits with no significant match action.

judged.play: 100T instantly swats down a flying Raze activate her Showstopper ultimate in mid-air.
judged.line: GET HIM OUT OF THERE! He doesn't even get the Showstopper off!
judged.reason: Extremely hilarious and impressive denial of a high-value ultimate with huge streamer hype.

judged.play: 100T survives a messy engagement on C site to secure a dominant 10-2 scoreline.
judged.line: I thought we died! What a save!
judged.reason: Good round conclusion to wrap up a dominant half, but lacks a single standout solo clip.

judged.play: Streamer reacts to the 10-2 halftime scoreline as ads play.
judged.reason: Standard halftime score reaction overlayed with promotional material.
